summary: Complete testing of Premium ATS Checks feature (Iteration 28). Backend: POST /api/career-tools/ats-check endpoint working with AI-powered analysis and MongoDB caching. Frontend: Full-screen ATS check panel with score ring, 5 category cards, keyword analysis with clickable missing keywords, job description input, re-check button. All 15 features tested and verified.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/career-tools/ats-check returns overall_score, overall_status, categories (5), keyword_analysis, summary_feedback
Backend: ATS check results are cached in MongoDB ats_checks collection (same data returns cached within 1 hour)
Backend: ATS check with job_description parameter returns targeted keyword comparison
Backend: Validation returns 422 for missing personal_details or empty request
Frontend: ATS Check button visible in wizard editor score toolbar
Frontend: Clicking ATS Check navigates to ats-check-view overlay
Frontend: Loading spinner shown while AI analysis runs
Frontend: Results page shows overall score with circular progress ring
Frontend: 5 category cards (Keyword Match, Format Safety, Section Completeness, Contact Info, Date Consistency) with scores, status icons, issues, and fixes
Frontend: Keyword Analysis section shows found keywords (green pills) and missing keywords (red pills with + Add button)
Frontend: Clicking missing keyword adds it to skills
Frontend: Job description textarea available for targeted keyword matching
Frontend: Re-check button clears results for new analysis
Frontend: Back to Editor button returns to wizard
Frontend: Score toolbar shows score number, ATS/Readability/Impact bars, Tips button, and PDF button
Frontend: All onboarding flow still works (Entry -> Level -> Years -> Industry -> Templates -> Wizard)
critical_code_review_comments: ATS check endpoint properly implements MongoDB caching with 1-hour TTL using hash-based lookup
AI response parsing includes fallback for JSON decode errors with sensible defaults
Frontend auto-runs ATS check when clicking the button (good UX)
Missing keyword pills are clickable and add to skills with toast notification
All 5 ATS categories properly displayed with progress bars, scores, issues, and fixes
Keyword analysis shows match percentage with color-coded progress bar
context_for_next_testing_agent: ATS Check feature fully implemented and tested. Key data-testids: 'ats-check-btn' (toolbar button), 'ats-check-view' (overlay), 'ats-loading' (spinner), 'ats-results' (results container), 'ats-overall-score' (score number), 'ats-category-{0-4}' (category cards), 'ats-keyword-bar' (match progress), 'ats-found-keyword' (green pills), 'ats-missing-keyword' (red pills with +Add), 'ats-job-desc' (textarea), 'ats-run-btn' (run button), 'ats-recheck-btn' (re-check), 'ats-back-btn' (back to editor). Backend endpoint: POST /api/career-tools/ats-check with MongoDB caching in ats_checks collection.
